# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-10-30):
> stock Strata v0.2.8 (engine 0.1.54) + stock OMP 18.14.0 across all three hosts and the Mac Studio route, rolling back
> to stock Strata v0.2.7 (engine 0.1.52) + stock OMP 18.13.2: on the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a`
> (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock layer split with stock roles
> `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, pipeline windows 2, no batch slots, display on
> the RTX 4090, and `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning stock `--ple-io direct` to keep the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding
> (PLE) table on direct SSD reads, preserving the engine's 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache and 27.9 GiB Windows
> commit headroom of a 135.7 GiB limit;
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json)),
> on an RTX PRO 6000 at the trained 262,144-token context with four batch slots, the engine's 8,192 MiB conversation
> parking and 32K chunks (`win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json)),
> and on an RTX 5090 (`rtx5090-win-a`), where the owner made the 262,144-token Coder IQ1_M profile the host's default
> (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json)),
> with an unchanged 36 GiB available-RAM start floor and a 3,584 MiB automatic conversation cache (31 parks in G19; G10
> serving: 11.17 GiB available RAM, 18.05 GiB commit headroom of an 85.15 GiB limit; G16 restart ready in 28.3 s, lowest
> available RAM 9.79 GiB). Operating condition for the RTX 5090 262K default: the host's Docker Desktop and WSL, which
> run its production NInfer container, must be stopped; after WSL restarts, that container must be recreated by the
> owner's pinned relaunch script and re-registered with the owner's fleet controller. The 131,072-token Coder IQ1_M
> profile (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json))
> is the qualified alternative for running with Docker Desktop and WSL up (the production container stopped by the fleet
> controller; 34 GiB start floor). Both RTX 5090 ledgers have 21 pass and 3 not applicable, retaining the main-chain G10
> listener-check failures on Windows build 26300.9818 beside the passing G10 reruns at `f9e8c74`.
> Stock Strata v0.1.40.3 + stock OMP 18.8.4 stays qualified for single-card RTX 3090 hosts
> ([ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.40.3-omp18.8.4/qualification.json)).
> All four server profiles roll back to v0.2.7 (engine 0.1.52) + OMP 18.13.2:
> [PRO, 262K (v0.2.7)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 262K default rollback (v0.2.7)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 131K alternative rollback (v0.2.7)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json),
> [pair, 262K PLE-direct rollback (v0.2.7)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json).
> On the pair's measurement-only [v0.2.8 stock-residency roles draft](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/manifest.json),
> upstream's [Niko1221/Strata#4518](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/4518) fix locked the 26.8 GiB PLE table
> (33.9-34.0 s), then gave the lock back on both starts and sized the automatic conversation cache at 4,864 MiB
> (106-112 s to ready), against 8,192 MiB and 61-63 s to ready with `--ple-io direct` at matching 100K-token time to
> first token (TTFT) (31.2 s vs 30.9 s), so the pair keeps `--ple-io direct`. The v0.2.8 campaign is complete across all
> five rows.
> The measurement-only v0.2.8 stock-residency pair draft, the held v0.2.7 roles draft (PLE in RAM), the unmeasured
> v0.2.7 default-split draft, the default and split-32 v0.2.3 pair drafts and the v0.1.44.1 pair release remain draft,
> not qualified.
> Each current local ledger has 21 pass and 3 not applicable. Real-host v0.2.8 receipts cite tooling commits `278e53c`
> on the PRO main run (operator receipts at `4853ab3`, G06 citing green [CI run 40989725083](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/actions/runs/40989725083) at `4853ab3`),
> `278e53c` on the RTX 5090 262K and 131K main runs with passing G10 reruns and operator receipts at `f9e8c74` (G06
> citing green [CI run 40996143852](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/actions/runs/40996143852) at `f9e8c74`),
> and `4853ab3` on the pair PLE-direct main run and operator receipts after admitting engine 0.1.54's stage order.
> Scored (G24): PRO 16/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.7: 15/18), RTX 5090 262K default 17/18 (pilot 6/6; v0.2.7: 16/18), RTX 5090
> 131K alternative 18/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.7: 16/18), current pair PLE-direct 15/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.7 PLE-direct
> rollback: 17/18). Per task on the four current v0.2.8 profiles: tool-loop 1/3 on PRO, 2/3 on RTX 5090 262K, 3/3 on
> RTX 5090 131K, and 0/3 on pair PLE-direct; every other task 3/3. Protocol counters (including malformed arguments and
> calls without results) are 0 across all four current v0.2.8 server profiles; all task failures stay counted.
> Scored batch walls are 788 s on the PRO (v0.2.7: 828 s), 865 s on the RTX 5090 262K default (v0.2.7: 755 s), 968 s on
> the RTX 5090 131K alternative (v0.2.7: 732 s) and 926 s on the current pair PLE-direct profile (v0.2.7: 1,029 s);
> these are not isolated decode latency. v0.2.8 ships its engine (0.1.54) as a separately versioned CUDA 13 component
> tarball staged into `runtime\strata\engine\`, reusing `locks/strata-python-cp313-win_amd64-strata0.2.7.txt` (26
> hash-locked wheels).
> On `rtx3090-win-a`, engine 0.1.54's stage order was admitted at `4853ab3` after the 2026-10-30 pair measurement:
> stock roles (`--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper`, RTX 4090 as Main staged last; layers 0-23 on the RTX 3090 with a 17.35 GiB
> expert cache and 24-47 on the RTX 4090 with 16.01 GiB, auto K=24, pipeline windows 2 decode-capable).
> The v0.2.3 + OMP 18.12.6 profiles across all three hosts, the v0.2.1 profiles on all three hosts (whose host
> integration roots were removed on 2026-10-28), the PRO and RTX 5090 v0.1.44.1 (including 262K), v0.1.43.1 and v0.1.43
> profiles, the pair's v0.1.43.1 and v0.1.43 profiles, and each host's v0.1.42 + OMP 18.8.9 profiles stay earlier
> qualified history. All earlier failed gates and passing reruns remain published.
> The pair's [earlier qualified 131K profile](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-disp4090-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> keeps the display on the RTX 4090; its
> [earlier predecessor](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> requires moving the display back to the RTX 3090. Single-card RTX 3090 profiles are not rollbacks
> while both cards are installed: they name GPU 0, now the RTX 4090. Earlier qualified history: on the RTX PRO 6000, stock Strata v0.1.41 + stock OMP
> 18.8.6 with the same choices at 262,144 tokens, then at 131,072 tokens, then the same choices on v0.1.40.3 + OMP
> 18.8.4, then OMP 18.8.3, then v0.1.40.2 + 18.8.0 without them; on the RTX 5090, v0.1.41 + OMP 18.8.6, then
> v0.1.40.3 + OMP 18.8.4, then stock Strata v0.1.34 + stock OMP 18.4.10, which also stays qualified on the
> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`, runs stock
  OMP 18.14.0 through an SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.8 262K profile. Its independent G23 passed on 2026-10-30 at `4853ab3`: missing key refused
  before launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 6.1-6.7 ms and stream TTFT 0.199 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight
  with the prior transcript preserved, and nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen (0.85 s), client restart (0.75 s)
  and verified server restart (1.65 s). Its qualified rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`,
  reaches the PRO's v0.2.7 262K rollback. The 0.2.3, 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1, 0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and
  `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands
